_doc: Canonical audit event vocabulary. `emitted` names MUST be emitted by both ports — a name present in one port and not the other is drift, and the parity test fails. `reserved` names are documented and intentionally not yet emitted; they are held so the string is not repurposed for something else later. Moving a name from reserved to emitted is the last step of implementing its emitter, in both ports, in the same change.
